why: Multiple post-snapshot papers (e.g. a 2024 arXiv preprint claiming finitely many Mersenne primes, and a 2025 Zenodo/ScienceOpen 'Note for the Perfect Numbers' by Frank Vega claiming a proof route) directly claim to resolve the infinitude of perfect numbers/Mersenne primes; these are unverified and contested, but a resolution claim is itself a routing signal. Separately, GIMPS found the 52nd Mersenne prime in Oct 2024 and confirmed the 50th in Sept 2025, but new examples do not bear on the infinitude question and are noted only as context.
